svg.title: Dark Factory customer journey
svg.desc: An authorized goal passes policy, budget, implementation, checks and independent review. Configured live delivery observes and recovers; evidence informs the next goal. Offline demonstrations simulate external actions.

g.text: Customer request → relevant context → useful outcome → next action
Evidence and learning → next reversible pilot goal
Unsafe or exhausted work stops. Failures route to bounded recovery or an incident.
Local preview: synthetic metrics. Offline scenarios: simulated external effects.
No live deployment, customer savings, or catalog certification is implied.
